translations.translation: You are finally willing to come back and see me.
translations.brief_source_paraphrase: 男主感叹对方终于回国相见

translations.translation: If it weren't for you back then, why would I have spent three years wandering abroad?!
translations.brief_source_paraphrase: 女主怨恨对方当年的行为导致自己被迫漂泊三年
